releaseNotes:
• Version 1.6 UI Purification: Complete replacement of mock reference screenshot elements with 100% real dynamic fitness UI.
• Real Athlete Profile: Replaced fake social/mock cards with genuine athlete metrics, current weight, height, and direct workout actions.
• Real Workout & Macro Pacing: Connected today's workout plan and daily macro budget cards with live Room database values.
• 9-Stream Hardware Sensor Telemetry: Live step count, cadence, pace, distance, elevation, and sleep estimates from phone hardware.
• Strict '-' Real-Data Integrity: Zero duplicate or synthetic values; unrecorded metrics display strictly as '-' across all cards and graphs.
